description: Andhra Pradesh Agriculture Department signs MoU with Wadhwani AI for smart farming
body_lead: In a major step towards modernising agricultural governance, the Andhra Pradesh Department of Agriculture on Tuesday signed a memorandum of understanding with Wadhwani AI, New Delhi, to deploy artificial intelligence for improving service delivery and decision-making in the farm sector. Andhra Pradesh Director of Agriculture Manazir Jeelani Samoon and J. P. Tripathi, Director (Agriculture), representing Wadhwani AI, signed the MoU in the presence of Executive Officer and Special Chief Secretary (Agriculture and Cooperation) Raja Sekhar.
